# FDGA039

> DO add the optional trailing comma after a property assignment from an object initializer, or addition via a collection initializer, when the initializer spans multiple lines.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.6 Other.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

planned-analyzer: missing trailing comma in multi-line initializers.

## From the book

Providing the trailing comma avoids unnecessary lines in a `diff` view of a change, where the formerly last line gains a comma.

```csharp
Right:
    public enum SomeEnum
    {
        First,
        Second,
        Third,
    }

Wrong:
    public enum SomeEnum
    {
        First,
        Second,
        Third
    }
```
